Brown Eyes (song) | "Brown Eyes" is a song by Fleetwood Mac from the 1979 double LP "Tusk".  It was one of six songs written and sung by Christine McVie. Sing for Your Supper | "Sing for Your Supper" is an American popular song by composer Richard Rodgers and lyricist Lorenz Hart.
